t: The opposite of $(l:programming/liquid_import)Fluid Import/$: the $(l:tools/drone)Drone/$ will move to the nearest tank within the specified $(l:programming/area)Area/$ to drop off fluid from its own tank.$(p)Additionally, the $(item)Drone/$ can place fluid in the world: to do so, check the $(thing)Place fluid in world/$ option in the widget GUI. Beware, $(item)Drones/$ can easily trap themselves while doing this!

与$(l:programming/liquid_import)流体导入/$相反：$(l:tools/drone)雄蜂/$会移动到指定$(l:programming/area)区域/$内最近的储罐，将自身储罐中的流体卸下。$(p)此外，$(item)雄蜂/$还可以在世界中放置流体：要这样做，请在该组件的 GUI 中勾选$(thing)放置流体/$选项。注意，$(item)雄蜂/$在这样做时很容易把自己困住！

You can specify to which side(s) of the tank the Drone should output its items in the widget GUI; you can also specify a maximum amount of exported fluid (in mB).$(p)You can $(ttcolor)$(t:Connect on the right to whitelist, on the left to blacklist)connect/$ a $(l:programming/liquid_filter)Fluid Filter/$ to limit what may be exported by the Drone.$(p)This widget is done when the $(item)Drone's/$ tank is empty (of applicable fluids), or when there's no tank within the area which will accepts the fluid.

你可以在该小部件的 GUI 中指定雄蜂应将物品输出到储罐的哪一侧；你也可以指定导出流体的最大数量（单位：mB）。$(p)你还可以$(ttcolor)$(t:Connect on the right to whitelist, on the left to blacklist)连接/$一个$(l:programming/liquid_filter)流体过滤器/$，以限制雄蜂可导出的内容。$(p)当$(item)雄蜂的/$储罐为空（没有适用的流体），或作用范围内没有可接受该流体的储罐时，此小部件即完成。
